create_openai_pipeline: create an OpenAI pipeline class that wraps the OpenAI chat completions API for use in Open WebUI
build_pipeline_valves: build a Pydantic Valves model to configure the OPENAI_API_KEY for the OpenAI pipeline
run_pipeline_pipe: run the pipeline pipe method to forward chat messages to the OpenAI API with streaming support
test_pipeline_on_startup: test the pipeline on_startup lifecycle hook that prints the module name on server start
review_pipeline_on_shutdown: review the pipeline on_shutdown lifecycle hook that prints the module name on server stop
